summary: Camera C0002001 at the Hannell St/Honeysuckle Dr intersection in Wickham has one counter across three zone sites from May 2024 to Feb 2025, with complete, single-record data. The few zero_outage fixes fall on camera-wide very low days and are restored. A sustained 2.5x rise from 8 Nov 2024 in four zones is plausibly real but unexplained, so it is flagged uncertain and kept; no series definitions are needed.
